import 'package:hazard_fixture/counter.dart';
import 'package:test/test.dart';

void main() {
  // The tests share one counter, and each relies on the one before it.
  test('reset', () {
    shared.reset();
    expect(shared.value, 0);
  });

  test('first bump', () => expect(shared.bump(), 1));

  test('second bump', () => expect(shared.bump(), 2));
}
